ir are you looking for today?
user: Do not book or save anything yet. Answer this first: What do a basic bicycle service and puncture repair cost, and are parts included?
assistant: A basic service costs four hundred ninety nine rupees and a puncture repair is one hundred twenty rupees. Parts are extra only after approval. Would you like to go ahead with an enquiry?
user: I do not want a basic service, but I need a puncture repair. Can you help?
assistant: Of course, I can help with a puncture repair at one hundred twenty rupees. Which locality are you in, so I can note this down for our team?
Caller shared contact details for the team to follow up.
You have answered my questions. I do not need anything else. Goodbye, end the call.
